artworks.title: Saint Lawrence
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The individual is facing slightly to the left, with their left arm bent at the elbow and their hand either resting on a hip or holding an object. Their right arm is extended downward, holding a palm branch and resting it on a grid-like structure. The person has delicate facial features with a gentle expression. Their hair is styled in soft curls that form a halo around the head, cut short above the ears. They are dressed in a long robe with wide sleeves, gathered and layered. The robe has decorative details along the edges. The person holds a book in their left hand. The grid-like structure has small protrusions. The background is plain, with no distinct features, focusing on the person and their attire.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16 x 15.3 cm (6 5/16 x 6 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an nativity scene. The image features a woman with a halo kneeling in prayer beside a manger where a baby lies. Surrounding her are two animals, an ox and a donkey, which are gazing towards the baby. Above the woman, cherubs are flying, and on the left, in the distant landscape, two figures can be seen approaching. The drawing captures the folds of the woman's attire and the expressions on the figures. The scene appears to celebrate a calm event set within a simple setting adorned with rural and spiritual elements.

artworks.title: Children's Pastime (Jeux d'enfants)
artworks.description: The image shows an overhead view of a park setting. The horizon is high, with soft outlines of trees and structures blending into the distance. In the foreground, a woman with a parasol is depicted in fluid brushstrokes, conveying motion. The brushwork is loose and lively, creating a carefree atmosphere. The color palette is warm, with bright yellow dominating and accents of blues and reds. Small figures and trees are seen in the background, with a light yellow sky above.

artworks.title: Tankard
artworks.description: The image shows a highly decorated tankard with an ornate handle and intricate designs covering its surface, including a detailed face motif in the center. The color palette is primarily black and white. The tankard is centrally positioned, with the handle curving to the right side. The lid is embellished with floral patterns and the initials "G W" are inscribed near the top.

artworks.title: Cup
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate goblet with decorative scrollwork and winged faces. The color scheme is black on a beige background. The goblet is centrally placed, with intricate designs on its body. Two winged cherub faces are positioned below the goblet, one on each side.

artworks.title: Untitled
artworks.description: This is a drawing of intricate ornamental designs. Three semicircular motifs are presented in a vertical alignment, each adorned with elaborate scrollwork and floral patterns. The uppermost and middle sections feature masks at the center, framed by symmetrical swirling designs. The lower section also includes a central mask with similar ornate flourishes. Below these motifs, the initials "G W" are inscribed in elegant script.

artworks.title: Goblet Design
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fan with an intricate design. The drawing shows symmetrical floral patterns and scrollwork covering the fan shape. The design includes stylized leaves, flowers, and vine patterns drawn with fine lines. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed decoration.

artworks.title: Fantastic Vases
artworks.description: The image includes five ornate vases with intricate designs and decorations in black and white tones. The vases are lined up in a row, evenly spaced. The first vase has horse motifs and a floral bouquet. The second vase has many roses. The third vase is the largest, with a face and script. The fourth vase is simpler with floral decorations, while the fifth vase has a face surrounded by swirls.

artworks.title: Fantastic Vases
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of several ornamental vases and containers filled with detailed flowers and foliage, surrounded by human-like figures and a large bird. The color palette is monochrome, using black linework on a beige background. On the left is a large vase with floral arrangements, two figures holding another vase, a wide low basin with figures and plants, curvaceous vessels holding plants, and a large vase with a bird-like shape and floral embellishments, with smaller containers beside it.

artworks.title: Fantastic Vases
artworks.description: The image shows an array of vases with unique designs, arranged in a monochrome color palette. From left to right, there are vases with floral adornments, figures with elongated beaks, cherub-like figures, sculptural elements, and rich decorations.

artworks.title: Fantastic Vases
artworks.description: The image shows a series of ornately designed vases filled with elaborate arrangements of flowers. The central vase is the largest and features intricate detailing and a figure leaning against it. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white with varying line thickness. The largest vase is positioned centrally, flanked by slightly smaller vases on either side, each containing a dense bouquet of flowers that extends outward and upward.

artworks.title: Fantastic Vases
artworks.description: The image displays a series of ornate vases with intricate designs and floral arrangements. The sketch is monochromatic, featuring shades of black and off-white. The vases vary in size and decoration. The left vase has intertwined swans, the central one has a goat head and rope-like decorations, and the right vase features human figures. Each vase is detailed with various patterns and motifs, situated closely together on a horizontal plane.

artworks.title: Fantastic Vases
artworks.description: The image shows various ornate decorative vases and containers. The objects are arranged in a row, with the largest vases in the center. The color scheme is black and white. The vases have intricate patterns and designs, including foliage, faces, and scenes. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Philosophy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical figure seated on a throne among symbolic representations. The imagery includes a central crowned figure holding a staff, surrounded by intricate designs and foliage. There are round medallions depicting ancient scholars or philosophers labeled with names such as "Geramor" and "Gregori" in the design. The corners of the image feature personified wind elements, with labels such as "Eurus" and "Zephir" blowing air towards the center. Throughout the piece, there are several inscriptions in Latin. The overall composition suggests a reverence for ancient wisdom and the merging of different cultural understandings of knowledge.

artworks.title: Apollo and the Muses
artworks.description: This is a drawing of classical figures surrounded by symbolic elements. The image features a central grouping of three primary figures, one of whom is marked as "Phebus," flanked by various other figures, each labeled with names such as "Urania," "Calliope," and "Melpomene." These figures are enclosed within circular frames that are integrated into an ornate border filled with floral motifs and scrolls. The figures appear to represent the classical muses and other mythological characters, with specific attributes or symbols they are often associated with, suggesting their roles and domains in mythology.

artworks.title: Celtes Surrounded by Greek and Roman Gods
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a complex allegorical scene with various mythological figures and symbols. The image is divided into panels, each containing detailed depictions of classical deities and mythical characters. In the central panel, there is a seated figure engaged in writing, surrounded by scrolls and books. Above, an owl flies across with Latin inscriptions. Surrounding this central scene are various figures including Minerva, Mars, Venus, Hercules, Mercury, Apollo, and Bacchus, each with distinguishing attributes. The image illustrates themes of art, poetry, music, and mythology in a style reminiscent of Renaissance artistry, though no single artist or style is indicated. The composition suggests a celebration or dedication of artistic and heroic virtues, framed with Latin phrases and an ornate border.

artworks.title: Apollo on Parnasus
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring various figures and symbols in a classical theme. There is a central figure with curly hair playing a stringed instrument under a tree. The scene includes temples, rabbits, mythical entities, and Latin inscriptions. The style is detailed with expressive figures and elements, resembling woodcut prints.

artworks.title: Flask
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornately decorated flask featuring intricate floral and vine-like patterns, a chain, a circular emblem with a detailed motif, scrolling foliage, and floral designs. Additional decorative elements are present on the neck and base of the flask, with the base elevated and supported by a broad, intricately patterned foot. The bold lines and attention to detail showcase the craftsmanship and artistic dedication involved in creating the design. The monogram "GW" is visible towards the bottom.

artworks.title: Tankard
artworks.description: The image shows a tankard with floral and scroll motifs in black and off-white colors. The tankard has intricate designs and a handle with a sculpted human figure and decorative elements. The top is flat with letters possibly indicating initials. The craftsmanship of the object is showcased in the composition.

artworks.title: The Ordeal by Arrows (Saint Sebastian)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.1 x 32.7 cm (6 5/16 x 12 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This image shows a wide and detailed landscape with ancient-looking ruins and figures, some on horseback and others on foot. The ruins resemble a coliseum and frame the scene on both sides, with a central pathway leading into the distance. The intricate brushstrokes are controlled and precise, reminiscent of etching, with fine lines defining the architecture and figures. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring black lines on a cream background. Figures and horses are depicted with rich detail in the foreground, blending into the landscape in the distance.

artworks.title: The Slave Market
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 11.4 × 21.9 cm (4 1/2 × 8 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This detailed drawing captures a bustling scene in an architectural setting. On the left, there is a large, multi-storied building with small windows and an extended upper level, along a street lined with people ascending and descending a staircase. To the right, a circular tower-like structure rises with brick or stone textures, including small windows and a balcony. The foreground includes figures in various period garments, some with feathered hats, congregating around the structures. Some animals, including a dog, wander amongst the people. The lines are precise, directing attention to the interaction between architecture and social activity.

artworks.title: Venus Anadyomene
artworks.description: The image shows a female figure in a side profile standing on rocks with her arms raised and hands at the top of her head. She has long hair, closed eyes, and a serene expression. The woman is nude and surrounded by seashells with a landscape background. The image is framed with a decorative border.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed in gray and black
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large, bearded figure carrying a child across a river. The scene is depicted with intricate line work and shading. The bearded figure is shown wading through the river, grasping a staff for support while carrying the child on their shoulder. The child is clothed in a hooded garment and gesturing with one hand. Surrounding them is a detailed landscape with trees, rocky formations, and distant mountains. Objects hang from tree branches in the upper background, and small figures are in the distance. Light and dark contrast creates a dramatic atmosphere. It is in the style of Albrecht Dürer.
